text.card: A red giant 6,119 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.00 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,054 K at its surface.
